override.title: Your Function Chart gives every function one accountable owner.
override.headline: Your Function Chart gives every function one accountable owner.
body: In Metronome: open Function Chart and confirm each owner.

override.support: In Metronome: open Function Chart. Test it against how the quarter really went.

body: What: one page per function, saying what success looks like.
Why: everyone knows what they own and how we measure it.
How often: every 90 days, scored 0, 1 or 2.
Who: the owner, then their team lead. Then they compare.

override.support: Put your KFFM on the screen.

override.title: Are you pushing all six levers?
override.headline: Are you pushing all six levers?
notes: At a quarterly, the six levers are the check on the KFFM. The map is only right if the team is using it to move more cash faster.
The levers are quantity, conversion, price, timing, capacity and cost. They are the ways the owner manages cash.
Timing is how long one widget takes to get through. Capacity is how many widgets a function can handle in a month. A function can be fast and still too small.
Use the example to name each lever. Then go to the team's own KFFM on the next slide.

override.support: In Metronome: open One Page Plans. Read it aloud. Is it still true? What changes?
In Metronome: open One Page Plans. If you have Core Values, read them aloud and test each one:

override.headline: Does your BHAG still hold?
override.title: Does your BHAG still hold?
override.support: In Metronome: open One Page Plans and read your BHAG aloud.
In Metronome: open One Page Plans. Read it aloud before you move on.
In Metronome: open Annual Priorities. Read it aloud before you move on.

override.title: Your QHAG is this quarter’s step toward your 1HAG.
override.headline: Your QHAG is this quarter’s step toward your 1HAG.
override.support: QHAG stands for Quarterly Highly Achievable Goal.

panels.heading: What does it build or move?
panels.support: It advances a 1HAG priority, or moves a KFFM lever that brings cash in faster.

panels.heading: How much will it move a critical number?
panels.support: Name the number and the target. If it barely moves, think twice.

panels.heading: How soon will we see it?
panels.support: Name the achieved-by date for the measure of success. If it takes a long time to show, think twice.

panels.heading: Who can own it and succeed?
panels.support: One person, with the capacity and the skills to deliver it.

panels.heading: What will it cost?
panels.support: Money, time and attention. Choose the most impact for the least cost.

override.support: Read your QHAG aloud from the board before you move on.

override.title: Your priorities are your step toward the QHAG.
override.headline: Your priorities are your step toward the QHAG.

body: Each individual priority supports a QHAG priority or the owner’s critical number.
The 1HAG and the QHAG each have ideally 3, up to 5 priorities.
Every priority has a done-by date and a measure of success.
Each QHAG priority advances a 1HAG priority.

override.headline: How are your meetings going?
override.title: How are your meetings going?

panels.heading: Daily huddle
panels.support: 7 to 10 minutes, every day except the day of the weekly meeting.
items: Metrics: yesterday’s widget actual and today’s forecast
The #1 thing to get done today
Stucks, and anything that can’t wait

panels.heading: Weekly 1:1
panels.support: 15 to 30 minutes. Each leader with each direct report, led by the direct report.

panels.heading: Weekly leadership meeting
panels.support: 60 minutes or less. The CEO owns it.

notes: Give it about 10 minutes, on the board’s Meeting Rhythm Check-In.
Rate each meeting that is running: 0 below, 1 meets, 2 exceeds expectations.
Quarterly Planning is running too: today is the first one the Kick Off booked.
The Monthly Town Hall starts this quarter. Book it before you leave, with its standing agenda, a year ahead.
The scoreboard shows last week’s widget forecast, the actual and this week’s forecast.
override.support: In Metronome: open Meetings. Running? Working? What to change? Rate 0 to 2.
